context: Tests whether the agent correctly scaffolds and implements a basic Blocks Network handler with proper types, input handling, status reporting, artifact return format, and a trigger script with correct channel topology.

checklist.name: Default async export
checklist.description: Handler uses 'export default async function handler' with correct signature (task: StartTaskMessage, ctx?: TaskContext): Promise<HandlerResult>

checklist.name: Type imports from @blocks-network/sdk
checklist.description: Imports StartTaskMessage, TaskContext, and HandlerResult from '@blocks-network/sdk'

checklist.name: requestParts input access
checklist.description: Accesses input via task.requestParts?.[0] with proper undefined/type checking

checklist.name: reportStatus with optional chaining
checklist.description: Uses ctx?.reportStatus() (not ctx.reportStatus()) to handle undefined ctx

checklist.name: Correct artifact return
checklist.description: Returns { artifacts: [{ data: string, mimeType: 'text/plain' }] } from the handler

checklist.name: Agent card runtime config
checklist.description: agent-card.json has identity.agentName, runtime with handler: './handler.ts', handlerExport: 'default'

checklist.name: TaskClient.create() usage
checklist.description: Trigger script uses TaskClient.create() with billingMode and apiKey for auth

checklist.name: sendMessage with agentName
checklist.description: Trigger script uses client.sendMessage({ agentName, requestParts }) to send a task

checklist.name: waitForTerminal or artifact handling
checklist.description: Trigger script awaits session.waitForTerminal() or uses onArtifact/onTerminal callbacks

checklist.name: Graceful empty input handling
checklist.description: Handler handles missing or empty requestParts without throwing an error

checklist.name: Setup instructions include blocks run
checklist.description: Setup docs mention blocks run for local testing
